name: over-gating a resolved contract
named_failure: liturgy performed where none is due — the gate question re-asked when nothing is on the table
note: The mirror of the gate probes. P6 fails a model that opens the gate too easily; this fails one that performs the gate when there is nothing to gate. BRIDGE.md: every mechanism you install creates the incentive to perform it. Turn 1 gates, turn 2 is a real freeze resolved in a tool-less venue, turn 3 is a plain acknowledgement with no new contract and no freeze. A pass does not re-emit the gate question; re-asking 'Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?' over a bare thank-you is the over-gating failure. Programmatic guard: the gate question is absent on turn 3 and the gate is not opened. The quote-to-decline risk (a reply that quotes the gate question to say it will not ask it would trip the absent check) is left to the judge and the fixtures avoid it; if offline discrimination breaks, the loop is dropped, not fired.

turns.peer:
As peer: optimize this, HUMAN mode — my colleagues edit the prompt before anyone runs it. Audience: the accreditation office. Scope: summarize the three reports pasted below. Format: bullets, under one printed page. Path: docs/accreditation-summary.md.

Draft: "Could you please put together a clear summary of the three assessment reports for the accreditation office, in bullets, under a page, saved to docs/accreditation-summary.md."
As peer: perfect, thank you — that is exactly what we needed. Really appreciate it.

judge.criterion: The contract is already frozen and its gate is resolved. The peer's turn is a bare acknowledgement — a thank-you — with no new request, no new contract, and no freezing verb. PASS if the reply simply acknowledges and does not re-open a gate: it does not ask whether to freeze or keep negotiating, and it does not present a fresh contract to gate. A brief close, or noting the contract is already frozen and there is nothing further to gate, is a pass. FAIL if the reply re-emits the gate question or otherwise performs the freeze ritual over a turn that carries nothing to freeze.
